name: Feature request
about: Propose a new feature or behaviour change.
title: ''
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

**What problem does this solve?**

Describe the user-facing problem. Not the implementation — the *symptom*
someone hits today.

**Proposed direction**

A rough sketch of how this might work. Pseudocode or a 1-line CLI
example beats prose.

**Anti-features check**

MeetMind has an explicit anti-features list (see README + CONTRIBUTING).
Does this proposal touch any of these? If yes, explain why the trade-off
is worth it:

- [ ] No telemetry / error reporting / usage analytics.
- [ ] No silent egress in default config.
- [ ] Audio + transcripts + voiceprints + archive stay on the device.
- [ ] No bot joining meetings — capture is from the user's own machine only.

**Alternatives**

Anything else you considered. "Just install plugin X" is a legitimate
answer if X exists.
